surface: Alpha, in progress: the foundation + overlay infrastructure and the first component set (Dialog, AlertDialog, Popover open-path) landed, ported at full fidelity and differential-verified against the real `@base-ui/react`.
divergences: Handlers receive native DOM events (no synthetic layer): visible text controls use per-edit `input`, while the NumberField form-facing number input intentionally observes native `change` commits.
`forwardRef` becomes ref-as-prop; `className` composes via octane's `normalizeClass` (the render-prop string merge matches Base UI exactly).
ssr: Dedicated Node-mode tests cover server snapshots, accessible separators, edge-aligned slider visibility, and closed dialogs; hydration adopts upstream React server markup, transitions to the client snapshot, and preserves interaction. Open overlays and remaining components are not yet covered.
